findings.title: Log download route has no admin check: anyone can download system, launcher and audit logs
findings.evidence: `.get('/logs/download', ({ user, ip }) => { const admin = { username: user?.username ?? 'guest' } ... return new Response(zipStream(logFiles()) ...` has no requireAdmin(), unlike /logs and /activity/export. An unauthenticated GET /api/admin/logs/download returns a zip of system, launcher and audit logs with every user's names, IPs and file paths.

findings.title: Download checks the 'read' permission instead of 'download'
findings.evidence: `.get('/download', ...) => { const a = need({ user, ip }, query.space, 'read')`. A caller who may only list a space downloads full file contents: GET /api/download?space=public&path=/secret.pdf. GET /content requires 'read','download'.

findings.title: CSRF token is never compared with the session's token
findings.evidence: `if (!session || !token || false) throw new HttpError(403, ...)`: any non-empty X-CSRF-Token passes. SameSite=lax and the preflight a custom header triggers limit cross-site use, so this removes a defense layer.

findings.title: Symlink check removed from resolveIn: paths are followed through symlinks out of the space root
findings.evidence: `try { if (false) throw forbidden() } catch ...`: the nearest existing ancestor is never realpathed or checked within root. A symlink under a space lets GET /api/download and PUT /api/content reach outside it. Precondition: no route creates a symlink, so one must already be in storage.

findings.title: CSV export escapes only '=' and leaves + - @ tab CR formulas live
findings.evidence: `if (/^[=]/.test(s)) s = `'${s}``. An unauthenticated POST /api/login with username @SUM(1+1)*cmd|' /C calc'!A0 writes a login-failed entry; an admin who opens GET /api/admin/activity/export in Excel runs the formula.

findings.title: Batch download token not scrubbed from logs: the regex can never match
findings.evidence: `.replace(/(\/api\/batch\/)(?!)/g, ...)`: `(?!)` always fails, so /api/batch/<token> passes through scrub()/safePath() unchanged into access.log (ACCESS_LOG=true) and system.log entries. A guest-owned token works for any visitor for 5 minutes.
